QuestInfo.name: Asking After Mr. Pickall, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p425#, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out #p431# in front of #m10003007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p425#, the City Clerk, asked me to check on #b#p900015##k, a resident of the city. Let's go see how #p900015# is doing. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I checked on #p900015#, a resident of #m10003000#. In a city like this, no news is the best news.

0.0: "I'm curious to know how #p900015#, one of our residents in #m10003000#, is doing lately. And hey, don't get the wrong idea—I'm absolutely NOT asking because I'm wondering if there's actually a lock out there that he failed to open or anything. Anyway, I'd appreciate it if you could go check on him for me.\r\n- #p425#"

1.0: What brings you here today, huh? Actually, I am very busy right now 'cause #p411# left a box yesterday for me to open, but I still cannot crack it! I don't know what is inside, but this lock is definitely not a normal lock, huh!
1.1: Opening boxes for people brings so much fun, you know? Some people lock it themselves and lose the key, some people bring boxes they obviously stole from someone, and some even bring their parents' safe! All kinds of crazy things happen!
1.2: But none of that matters to me, #p900015#! I open the customer's lock, customer pays me the money, and we keep the deal a total secret, huh? Very simple! Just like that, huh!

level.0: But you... your level seems a bit too low, doesn't it?
